snippet.title: Leyla In Veil - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Leyla In Veil is an HD-2D pixel-style side-scrolling action shooter survival horror game. Players will take on the role of Laila, a senior agent from a mysterious organization, partnering with her companion Flora to investigate a bizarre art gallery.
